dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The 3-5 most prominent structures are circular and semi-circular with high-contrast, light-colored perimeters. These perimeters show a sharp edge transition from the dark surrounding field to the lighter ring, with some perimeters exhibiting minor fragmentation along the circumference.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Clusters of small, irregular light-colored pixel groups are concentrated on the anterior dorsal region. These blobs lack internal gradient transitions and appear as solid-intensity patches with high spatial density near the neck, becoming more dispersed towards the mid-section.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest rings on the upper mid-section form a scalene triangle. Relationships between these centroids and smaller adjacent clusters on the lateral flank create a series of interconnected, non-regular geometric patterns.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive overlapping of high-contrast rings creates a complex, interlocking lattice pattern across the mid-dorsal and lateral areas.
